messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

message.content:
Below is a list of **federal long‑weekends** in Canada for the year 2023.  
A long‑weekend occurs when a public holiday falls on a Friday or Monday (or is observed on one of those days), giving you a continuous break from Saturday through Monday.

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Day of Week | Long‑Weekend Span |
|---------|-------------|-------------|-------------------|
| New Year’s Day (observed) | Jan 2 | Monday | Dec 31 – Jan 2 |
| Family Day (Alberta, BC, NB, NL, PEI, SK, ON, MB) | Feb 20 | Monday | Feb 18 – Feb 20 |
| Good Friday | Apr 7 | Friday | Apr 7 – Apr 9 |
| Victoria Day | May 22 | Monday | May 20 – May 22 |
| Canada Day (observed) | Jul 3 | Monday | Jul 1 – Jul 3 |
| Labour Day | Sep 4 | Monday | Sep 2 – Sep 4 |
| Thanksgiving | Oct 9 | Monday | Oct 7 – Oct 9 |
| Christmas Day | Dec 25 | Monday | Dec 24 – Dec 26 |

> **Note:**  
> - The dates above reflect the *official* federal holidays that create long‑weekends.  
> - Some provinces have additional holidays (e.g., St. Patrick’s Day in Newfoundland & Labrador, Civic Holiday in Ontario, etc.) that may also generate long‑weekends. If you need provincial-specific long‑weekends, let me know which province(s) you're interested in.
